mapper.select: SELECT C.COURSE_ID AS courseId, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, C.START_DATE AS startDate, C.END_DATE AS endDate, CEIL(C.END_DATE - SYSDATE) AS dDay, CASE WHEN C.END_DATE < SYSDATE THEN 'CLOSED' WHEN C.STATUS = 'W' THEN 'WAITING' ELSE 'IN_PROGRESS' END AS courseStatus FROM COURSE C WHERE C.STATUS != 'N' ORDER BY C.CREATE_DATE DESC
SELECT NOTICE_ID AS noticeId, NOTICE_TITLE AS noticeTitle, CREATED_DATE AS createdDate FROM NOTICE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY CREATED_DATE DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
